title: Palace tells Bato's camp: 'Huwag nang magmatigas'
summary: Malacanang urged Sen. Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa not to be difficult in facing arrest even as it emphasized that the Philippine National Police will exercise its mandate to enforce the law.
